Installation

Requirements

YAMAMI requires Python 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, or 3.12.

Basic Installation

Install the latest stable version from PyPI:

pip install yamami

Installation with Extras

YAMAMI provides optional dependency groups for different use cases:

Development Dependencies

For testing and development:

pip install yamami[dev]

This installs:

  • pytest

  • pytest-cov

Documentation Dependencies

For building documentation:

pip install yamami[docs]

This installs:

  • sphinx

  • sphinx-rtd-theme

  • sphinx-intl

All Dependencies

Install all optional dependencies:

pip install yamami[dev,docs]

Installation from Source

Clone the repository and install in editable mode:

git clone https://github.com/NIES/yamami.git
cd yamami
pip install -e .

For development:

pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"

Core Dependencies

YAMAMI depends on the following packages (installed automatically):

Package

Purpose

numpy

Numerical computing

pandas

Data manipulation

opencv-python

Image processing

scipy

Scientific computing

pillow

Image I/O and EXIF

tqdm

Progress bars

matplotlib

Visualization

segment-anything

SAM3 segmentation

image-matching-models

Feature matching

Verifying Installation

Verify YAMAMI is installed correctly:

import yamami
print(yamami.__version__)

Run the test suite:

pytest tests/

Platform Notes

macOS

On Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3), PyTorch and related packages may need to be installed with the MPS backend for GPU acceleration. See PyTorch installation documentation for details.

Linux

For headless servers, ensure a display backend is available for matplotlib:

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')  # Set non-interactive backend

YAMAMI automatically uses the Agg backend when imported.

Windows

No special configuration is required for Windows.

Troubleshooting

ImportError: No module named ‘yamami’

Ensure YAMAMI is installed in the active Python environment:

pip show yamami

OpenCV Installation Issues

If opencv-python fails to install, try:

pip install opencv-python-headless

SAM Model Download

The Segment Anything Model (SAM) checkpoints are downloaded automatically on first use. Ensure internet connectivity and sufficient disk space (~2.4 GB).
